intent_record.intent_summary: Corrects buffer state management by clearing the pending release flag when the underlying release operation fails.
intent_record.what: Moved the BUF_ATTR_PENDING_RELEASE flag setting to occur before the session_release_buf call and added logic to clear the flag if the call returns an error.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the buffer attribute accurately reflects the release attempt status; if the release operation fails, the pending flag is removed to prevent inconsistent state tracking.

vuln_statements.explanation: This function manages buffer lifecycle and releases internal buffers. Based on the relevance score (0.85) and the description indicating potential use-after-free or double-free vulnerabilities due to improper synchronization of buffer state tracking (pending release flags) with concurrent accesses, this function represents the vulnerable code location where race conditions could occur during buffer release operations.
